_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 47: EU Declaration of Conformity
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity. No harmonised standard is requested for Article 47. Article 47(5) empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts updating the content of the EU declaration of conformity in Annex V in light of technical progress.
basis: EU AI Act Annex V -- EU Declaration of Conformity content requirements
_metadata.awaiting_standard: No harmonised standard is requested for Article 47. Article 47(5) empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts updating the content of the EU declaration of conformity in Annex V in light of technical progress.

requirements.title: EU Declaration of Conformity Document
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST draw up a written machine readable, physical or electronically signed EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk AI system that identifies the system, states that it meets the requirements set out in Section 2 of Chapter III, contains the information set out in Annex V and is translated into a language that can be easily understood by the national competent authorities of the Member States in which the system is placed on the market or made available (Article 47(1) and (2)). Where the system is subject to other Union harmonisation legislation which also requires an EU declaration of conformity, a single declaration MUST be drawn up in respect of all Union law applicable (Article 47(3)). The provider MUST keep the declaration up-to-date as appropriate (Article 47(4)).
requirements.rationale: Art. 47(1) requires the provider to draw up 'a written machine readable, physical or electronically signed EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk AI system'; Art. 47(2) requires it to 'contain the information set out in Annex V'.
required_content: AI system name and type and any additional unambiguous reference allowing the identification and traceability of the AI system (Annex V, point 1)
Name and address of the provider or, where applicable, of their authorised representative (Annex V, point 2)
Statement that the EU declaration of conformity is issued under the sole responsibility of the provider (Annex V, point 3)

Statement that the AI system is in conformity with this Regulation and, if applicable, with any other relevant Union law that provides for the issuing of the EU declaration of conformity (Annex V, point 4); where the AI system involves the processing of personal data, a statement that it complies with Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680 (Annex V, point 5)
References to any relevant harmonised standards used or any other common specification in relation to which conformity is declared (Annex V, point 6)

Where applicable, the name and identification number of the notified body, a description of the conformity assessment procedure performed, and identification of the certificate issued (Annex V, point 7)
Place and date of issue of the declaration, the name and function of the person who signed it, an indication for, or on behalf of whom, that person signed, and a signature (Annex V, point 8)
acceptable_formats: Machine-readable digital document (JSON, XML, PDF/A with structured data)
Physical signed document with digital copy

requirements.title: 10-Year Retention
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST keep the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, and MUST submit a copy to the relevant national competent authorities upon request (Article 47(1)).
requirements.rationale: Art. 47(1) requires the provider to keep the declaration 'at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service'.

scoring.partial: R01 met but incomplete Annex V coverage or no retention plan
